_comment: Evernahn period ship used to replace the modern SS_TIDAL at the Pelluca dock.

source.component: largest connected opaque region; the 32x128 strip at c7 is a SEPARATE object and excluded

recolour.method: the 7 greys (95.3% of the ship) mapped to an oak ramp at MATCHING luminance; red trim (4.1%) and mast highlight left alone
recolour.note: wood tones snapped to multiples of 8 (GBA is 5-bit/channel); luminance preserved within ~1

sprite_build.why_96x40: gObjectEventGraphicsInfo_SSTidal uses sOamTables_96x40; no 112x64 table exists, so 96x40 avoids a new subsprite table entirely
sprite_build.downscale: MODE (most-common colour per block), block drawn only if >=40% opaque; NEVER averaging
sprite_build.result: 70x40 ship centred at x13 in a 96x40 canvas
sprite_build.planks: applied AFTER downscale at final resolution, every 3 rows from 45% height, by stepping DOWN the same wood ramp so no palette slot is spent
sprite_build.palette: index 0 = transparent (0,123,197, reused from the original), 10 opaque colours

blast_radius: OBJ_EVENT_GFX_SS_TIDAL is used by 11 maps (incl. RivetshoreCity_Harbor, UnchartedIsland, Championship) - all now show the period ship. For Pelluca-only, add a separate OBJ_EVENT_GFX id instead.
future: The metatile route (Option B) should reuse ship_wood_source.png; slice the 109x62 game-scale form into a 7x4 metatile block in the Pelluca SECONDARY tileset.
